title: Mass drone attack on Moscow grounds flights at region's airports
summary: Over a hundred drones have been shot down en route to the Russian capital, Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin claimed.

title: Czechia could deliver first four L-39 Skyfox jets to Ukraine in 2027, foreign minister says
summary: The L-39 Skyfox, manufactured by Czech company Aero Vodochody, is a subsonic jet primarily designed for military pilot training. It can also carry out light attack, reconnaissance, and aerial patrol missions.

title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,618,920 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
summary: The number includes 2,590 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

title: 3 injured, dozens evacuated after Russian drone damages Kyiv medical facility in overnight attack
summary: A downed drone caused a fire at a medical facility in the capital's Shevchenkivskyi district in the early morning, partially destroying its second floor, according to Ukraine's State Emergency Service. Seven people in the facility had to be rescued by first responders.

title: US service member accused of attempting to spy for Russia identified, media reports
summary: A U.S. Army officer who was arrested in England for allegedly attempting to pass sensitive information to Russia was identified as Lt. Col. Brandon Tyner on Nov. 12.

title: Volgograd oil refinery, Rostov-on-Don production facility in flames following Ukrainian drone attack
summary: Eyewitness footage from the scene appears to show flames emanating from the Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka refinery, one of Russia's largest oil refineries with an annual crude oil processing capacity of 15 million metric tons.
